score_notes.A: Arc is clean (TL;DR, background, method, implementation, results, significance/limitations), no body H1, no skipped levels, real table, display math has blank lines. Deduction: L51 uses bare single dollar signs in body text '비용 $0.10)와 B(비용 $0.40)', which the rubric forbids ('no single $'); with inline-$ MathJax this pairs into a math span. L61-63 list mixes a full sentence ('신호가 약하기 때문입니다.') with noun fragments. Section headings are topic names, not claims (L19, L29, L57, L69, L95).
score_notes.B: Register is consistent 입니다 and terms mostly established. Deductions: L31 '체인 오브 소트로 상황을 분석하고' is a transliteration (-> 'Chain-of-Thought(CoT)로 상황을 분석하고'); L35 noun frame '주목할 부분은 세 종류의 도구가 같은 인터페이스로 묶여 있다는 점입니다' (-> '구조도에서 세 종류의 도구는 모두 같은 인터페이스로 묶입니다'); L97 '프런티어 모델을 넘을 수 있음을 보여 줍니다' (-> '작은 조율 모델이 ... 프런티어 모델을 넘습니다'); L99 formulaic opener '한계도 분명합니다.'; terms like '클리핑된 대리 목적 함수' (L55), '어드밴티지' (L55), '마르코프 결정 과정' (L31) get no English on first use.
score_notes.C: Motivation (biased prompted orchestrators, L23-27) leads naturally into the reward design and the results reuse the bias story (L87). Deductions: L55 introduces GRPO's 'clipped surrogate objective' with no definition and it never returns; L93 crams unseen-tool generalization, unseen pricing and preference results into one paragraph, which reads as a dump.
score_notes.D: Hard part (reward vector, batch min-max normalisation, preference dot product) gets formula plus a labelled toy example (L51) and a key-idea box (L53). Deductions: the L51 example ignores that the wrong trajectory C is also in the batch, so 'A가 1, B가 0으로 정규화' holds only if C's cost lies between $0.10 and $0.40 (C's cost is never given); L93 preference scores '46.7, 68.4, 79.5' are not explained (sum of preference-aware rewards relative to Qwen3-8B, per Appendix L) until a one-clause caveat in L99; GRPO clipping (L55) left unexplained.
score_notes.E: One results table copied cell-for-cell from the paper's main table (L75-83), three figures placed at their discussion and described without paper numbering. Deductions: L85 mis-describes what was cut ('도구 없음 구성과 Llama 계열 일부 행은 생략') when all Llama-Nemotron/Llama-3.3-70B rows, the basic-tools Qwen3-8B/Qwen3-235B rows and the reported-SOTA rows are also gone; L93's 12 numbers across three tables would read better as a small table.
score_notes.F: 13 of 15 sampled claims check out, including every table cell. Deductions: L99 ' 성능의 상당 부분은 여전히 GPT-5 같은 프런티어 모델 호출에서 나오므로' is unsupported (the paper gives no attribution of accuracy to GPT-5 calls; Orchestrator calls GPT-5 1.6 times per instance, Table 15); L87 attaches the cost '30.2센트에서 9.2센트' to HLE ('HLE에서 ... 비용은') although cost is the HLE+FRAMES average; L85 omitted-rows note is inaccurate; L27 'Orchestrator-8B는 ... 비교적 고르게 나눕니다' is read off a figure.
